 MMBets: Dallas finds themselves in a tough spot against Indiana
 Haliburton’s long awaited home return figures to make a tough spot for the Mavs
 by Tyler Edsel Oct 23, 2026, 5:00 PM UTC Facebook 
 Link 
 After an equal parts defeating yet somewhat inspiring 128-110 loss to the Houston Rockets, the Dallas Mavericks (0-1) remain on the road as they are set to square off against the Indiana Pacers (1-0). The Mavs found themselves down by as many as 37 points against Houston on Wednesday, before somewhat reeling Houston back in throughout the second half.
 Indiana, for their part, snagged a road win to start the year in New Orleans against the Pelicans. Tyrese Haliburton made his return from the torn achilles he suffered in Game 7 of the 2025 NBA Finals and picked up right where he left off. This Pacers team, now with Ivica Zubac in the fold at center, figures to be right back where they were two seasons ago. It will be a tall task for Dallas to get this one home.
 Game intangibles
 Dallas Mavericks (0-1) at Indiana Pacers (1-0) 
 Tipoff: We’re set for tip just after 6:10 p.m. from the Gainbridge Fieldhouse in Indianapolis, Indiana
 How to watch: MavsTV, KFAA Channel 29, or NBA League Pass for those out of market will have you covered on this one
 Game lines
 Odds via the Fanduel Sportsbook and are subject to change 
 Spread: Pacers -7.5 (-110)
 Moneyline: Dallas is +225 to pull off the upset
 Total: Over/Under is set at 239.5 points (-110/-110)
 Game plays
 Indiana -7.5 (-110) 
 Ivica Zubac over 27.5 points + rebounds (-110) 
 Obi Toppin under 12.5 points (-118) 
 Zaccharie Risacher over 8.5 points (-132) 
 This is an awful spot for the Mavericks to walk into. This is the Pacers home opener, and it will be a very charged up atmosphere with Tyrese Haliburton playing his first home game since Game 6 of the 2025 NBA Finals. I just don’t know how Dallas finds a way here, especially given Rick Carlisle’s voodoo magic he holds over the Mavs. Ivica Zubac has a wonderful matchup here against Daniel Gafford, who simply doesn’t rebound the ball at all. I also would like to fade Obi Toppin, who scored 20 off the bench against the Pelicans on great shooting. Finally, maybe in that second half of the Houston game, Risacher found something. I’ll go over the point total here.
 Other games on the card:

 Well, a rough day was bound to happen at some point, and yesterday was that day. The Cavs blew a 29-point lead at Philly, and in the process didn't cover. The Patriots did not win, nor did the game go under. BUT, Joe scratched out a win with SGA under 6.5 assists. 
 Today brings a ton of new opportunities, with a big NBA slate and a couple games on the extras card. Good luck!
